description: 0xSero's one-Spark vLLM profile for GLM-5.3-Flash, from GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-1x-DGX-Spark at 6ff8595a (CHANGELOG 1.1.2): the public 0xSero/GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-TR3-2.0bpw K2 checkpoint (EXL3 2.0 bpw, codebook mcg, about 111 GB; the GitHub repository description says 2.33 bpw while its scripts and docs pin 2.0 bpw), the model's own native MTP layer 45 as a depth-2 speculator (all 288 experts, unquantized; the draft view is derived at container start with upstream's tools/prepare_mtp_draft.py as symlinks plus a filtered index over the same checkpoint), B12X sparse-attention backend, packed fp8_ds_mla KV cache, CUDA graphs on target and draft, glm47 reasoning and tool parsers, image input, 262144-token context, one sequence. The image is upstream's public arm64 b12x-mtp-1xspark-v2 build (a pinned local-inference-lab vLLM fork), pinned by digest. Upstream claims, not measured here: 18.7 to 19.2 tok/s single-stream decode flat across the window with sampling on, about 570 tok/s prefill at 4k, 727449 KV tokens; this kit's docs list 2048 for max-num-batched-tokens while its scripts use 7168, which is what is packaged. Licences are informational: the repository declares MIT while GitHub reports no detected licence, and the weights repository card says MIT. The separate M288-12L mosaic path of upstream (SGLang, no MTP) is a different recipe. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: GPU utilization 0.93 → 0.85. Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint. This deviates from the upstream memory profile to avoid unified-memory thrashing; context and other kit flags are retained with a smaller KV pool.
title: GLM 5.3 Flash EXL3 K2 native-MTP vLLM single Spark (0xSero)
